subject: POC sandbox: confirm split-day load windows & prompt routing review
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@bluewave.com>, eng+qa@bluewave.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC sandbox: confirm split-day load windows & prompt routing review

Hi Alex / Bluewave team,

Thanks again for scheduling the POC. To make the hands-on sections (prompt review, routing checks, and the throughput bench runs) as smooth as possible we want to confirm a couple of logistics before we lock the calendar:

- Timezone / window: you mentioned preference for mornings PT. We recommend two split windows over two consecutive days to isolate prompt + routing tuning (day 1) from sustained load runs (day 2):
  - Day 1: 09:30–12:00 PT — prompt playback + routing matrix (low-load, step-up).
  - Day 2: 08:00–12:30 PT — progressive throughput runs (burst, steady-state, and long tail).
- Targets / SLOs: proposed targets for the benchmark runs are 800 req/s aggregate with 95th-% latency target of <= 220ms for the main model (gpt-redwood-7b-quant). If you need different targets for a canary model, tell us and we’ll add a second pass.
- Test harness: we’ll use our playback harness and the runbook we've attached (runbook_v1.pdf). The harness needs a service account token with read-only access to your input prompt set; we can accept a temporary pre-signed upload if you prefer.
- Prompt routing checks: please confirm the 6 canonical prompt IDs you want included (we attached the test matrix csv). If you don’t have IDs yet, send representative prompt samples and we’ll map them.

Action items for Bluewave: pick preferred slot (we can compress to 1.5 days if necessary), confirm throughput target, and share prompt samples or IDs. We’ll produce a detailed run order and a shared calendar invite once you confirm.

Attachments: poc_test_matrix.csv, runbook_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex@bluewave.com>, eng+qa@bluewave.com
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC sandbox: confirm split-day load windows & prompt routing review

Soojin — quick technical note for scheduling:

- For the Day 2 sustained runs at ~800 req/s we should reserve a short pre-warm (20 min) to populate KV caches and avoid cold-start tail latencies. Can we ask Bluewave to allow the first 20 minutes as a warm-up?
- Also, are we running the test harness from our hosted runner or are they providing an in-VPC agent? If in-VPC, we'll need SSH access info and the agent image tag by EOD Friday.

I'll draft a short run-order and capacity checklist after Alex confirms slots.

—Aditya
Principal Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Alex Rivera <alex@bluewave.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC sandbox: confirm split-day load windows & prompt routing review

Thanks, Soojin — this looks good. A few notes from our side:

- We can do the split schedule but prefer compressing into 1.5 days (Day 1 afternoon + Day 2 morning) so our product and infra folks don't have two full mornings blocked. Proposed concrete slots:
  - Day 1: Jun 15, 13:00–16:00 PT — prompt review + routing checks.
  - Day 2: Jun 16, 07:30–11:30 PT — load runs (we can extend to 12:00 if needed).
- Throughput: we’re comfortable with the 800 req/s target for the main model; we’ll also ask your team to run one canary at 250 req/s against the quantized variant.
- Warm-up: yes, please do a 20-minute warm-up before sustained windows.
- Test harness: we’ll use your hosted runner for simplicity. I’ll upload our prompt sets and provide the pre-signed link by EOD Friday.

I attached the partial prompt set and a CSV with the canonical IDs (see poc_test_matrix.csv). Also flagged a compliance checkbox — we’ll need a brief note on data retention for logs during the bench.

Attachments: poc_test_matrix.csv

Regards,
Alex Rivera
Head of Engineering | Bluewave Analytics
alex@bluewave.com | +1 (206) 555-0199

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@bluewave.com>, eng+qa@bluewave.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC sandbox: confirm split-day load windows & prompt routing review

Alex — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming we’ll schedule:

- Day 1: Jun 15, 13:00–16:00 PT — prompt playback + routing matrix (we’ll leave 15–15:15 for a short sync/checkpoint).
- Day 2: Jun 16, 07:30–11:30 PT — load runs (20 min warm-up + three progressive ramps: 250 -> 500 -> 800 req/s, then a 30-min steady-state at 800).
- Canary: one targeted run at 250 req/s against the quant variant.

Action items (who/when):
- Bluewave: upload the final prompt set to the Drive link and confirm the pre-signed upload by Fri EOD (Alex).
- Aditya: draft the run-order and warm-up sequence and share by Mon 6/8.
- Marissa: I’ll generate the calendar invites and attach the runbook; will include the HubSpot deal link.

I’ve attached the runbook (runbook_v1.pdf) and updated the test matrix we received. I’ll send the calendar invite in the next hour with the slots above. If anything changes, reply-all and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
